items.prompt: A coupon payment is USD 31.25. Settlement is 91 actual days into an actual 181-day coupon period. Calculate accrued interest in USD.
A bond has a clean cash price of USD 9,178.125 and accrued interest of USD 15.711. Calculate its dirty invoice price in USD.
items.explanation: Dirty price = clean price + accrued interest = USD 9,193.836.
